{"format":"org.dxos.dx-svg@1","version":1,"root":"0000000000000CQ3K30KZ838RX","source":{"language":"dsl","text":"diagram flow=down
group entry "Entrypoints" {
  node Entry "Entrypoints" ref="edge/packages/services/db-service/src/worker/entrypoint"
  node Handlers "API handlers" ref="edge/packages/services/db-service/src/worker/api-handler"
  node Registry "SpaceRegistry" ref="edge/packages/services/db-service/src/worker/space-registry/space-registry-object.ts"
}
group objects "Durable Objects" {
  node Ssm "SpaceStateMachine" ref="edge/packages/services/db-service/src/worker/space/space-state-machine.ts"
  node Subduction "Subduction repl." ref="edge/packages/services/db-service/src/worker/subduction"
  node FeedSpace "FeedSpace" ref="edge/packages/services/db-service/src/worker/feed-space/feed-space.ts"
  node FeedRep "FeedReplicator" ref="edge/packages/services/db-service/src/worker/feed/feed-replicator.ts"
  node Indexer "Indexer" ref="edge/packages/services/db-service/src/worker/indexer/indexer.ts"
  node Query "QueryExecutor" ref="edge/packages/services/db-service/src/worker/query/query-executor.ts"
  node Meta "SpaceMetadata" ref="edge/packages/services/db-service/src/worker/space-metadata/space-metadata.ts"
}
group bindings "Bindings" {
  node R2 "R2 space-backups" ref="edge/packages/services/db-service/src/worker/bindings.ts"
  node Ext "router / kms / compute" ref="edge/packages/services"
}
edge Entry -> Ssm "credentials"
edge Entry -> Subduction "automerge sync"
edge Entry -> FeedSpace "feeds"
edge FeedSpace -> FeedRep "replicate"
edge Subduction -> Indexer "doc changes"
edge Indexer -> Query "index lookup"
edge Registry -> Entry "registry queue"
edge Meta -> R2 "backups"
edge Subduction -> Ext "ROUTER_MESSENGER"
edge Entry -> Ext "KMS / FUNCTIONS"
edge Handlers -> Entry
